text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I ought to have expected this, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(I've no reason to assume she'll be this
way
forever, but neither can I expect a
change to
simply occur unprovoked. This
will be our normal,
for the moment at
least...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Many Umamusume strive to realize their
dreams
alongside close
rivals—encouraging one another
to
endure and improve.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Though, if I were to suggest that Sirius
and I
foster such a relationship, I'd be
met with a snort
and little else.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: (...What am I to do?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm. A peculiar quandary, and to be mine of all people. It's as if I'm fretting over the trials and tribulations of making my very first friend.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What an adorable thing for you to be
worried
about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki. ...You were listening?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To your Sirius-related troubles? I was! I
also heard
about the little confrontation
you two had the
other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Into one ear a rumor goes, and out many
mouths
it leaves. But to have spread this
fast...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We're all very worried, you know. But...

personally, I think your dynamic is fine
as it is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Just as it is now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Exactly. Come now, surely there's a sort of heat that could only be generated from the friction between you two?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking back to my office after
training, I
catch sight of Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you. We meet again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember, the last time I saw
her, we
discussed her relationship with
Sirius Symboli. I
ask how things are going
on that front.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, according to Fuji Kiseki, there's
something
to be said for the "heat" our
dynamic sparks. I've
been mulling that
over.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...But it would take something rather
dramatic to
inspire a change in our
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if we had something to reflect on,
it would
be difficult to comprehend on
mutual terms.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Stand by the fire and you risk getting
singed...
Surely, this heat born of our
relationship is
corrupted. Could such
energy serve as fuel for the
student
body, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Stand by the fire and you risk getting
singed...
Surely, this heat born of our
relationship is
corrupted. Could such
energy serve as fuel for the
student
body, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A demonstration?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It can't be that Sirius Symboli hates
Symboli
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But though I might be confident, I can't
provide
proof for someone else's
feelings. Still, it's got to
be something
different going on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Something going on that isn't hate... But
even if I
were to accept your
presumption, Sirius, she...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You can't have closure if you don't know
the
other party's feelings. The best they
can do is to
continue butting heads as
they speed toward
their goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if their paths don't cross, the
strength they
channel from being at
odds with each other
should drive them
both forward, giving rise to a
heat that
isn't corrupt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It would be a vivid heat that entrances
those
watching and entices them to
come closer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Trying to accept Sirius's feelings
will only
distort matters. Perhaps pure
heat is something
plainer, simpler.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I will endeavor to move
forward, so
that I might clash with her
head-on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I've reclaimed a firm grasp
over what I
must do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf breathes a small sigh of
relief and
looks up at the sky. Her
expression seems less
clouded than
before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It depends on me? ...Do you mean to say
I must
resolve this issue on my own?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter what kind of heat
you're up
against. As long as you're
ready to deal with it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Any heat, no matter its form, can be
changed.
Demonstrate that.
Demonstrate that there's
nothing to fear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So it's a question of how I handle her...
Perhaps I
should show everyone my
answer, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. That's how I've always
done things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I let people watch from behind as I blaze
a trail.
So, for as long as I remain calm
and composed,
those around me will
remain at ease.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. You're exactly right. Hehe. It
appears
that when it comes to Sirius, I
can't help but
overheat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I shall turn this passion into fuel, so the
many
attendees of this academy might
spend their time
here with serenity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sporting a cool smile, Symboli Rudolf
embodies
dignity perfectly befitting her
title of "Emperor."
